name: undo-diff-flags
description: `undo --diff --semantic` is a read: with nothing snapshotted it reports that and exits 0, and it must never fall through to a restore. That last part is the reason `--semantic` implies `--diff` in the parser — argv reaching `undo` still carries process-level flags it does not recognise (the harness appends `--script` right here), so an unrecognised review flag cannot be rejected, and a command that recognised nothing would run the destructive branch by default. `stdoutAbsent` pins that: no 'Restored' line for a flag combination that only ever meant 'show me'
